tooltips.usageMetricsVersion: Version of the format used to record LLM calls for each agent run. Empty means per-call records are unavailable, not zero calls or zero cache hits. Report coverage is the percentage of runs with these records.
tooltips.modelRequestCount: Number of completed LLM calls, including the main agent and knowledge-base search. One agent run can make multiple LLM calls. A tool call does not necessarily correspond to one LLM call. Transport failures without a completed provider call are excluded.
tooltips.mainUsageRequestCount: Main agent calls with valid input, cached input and output token counts. Only these calls contribute to the main agent token totals, average input tokens per call and cache hit rate per call. Calls without complete metrics are not counted as cache misses.
tooltips.mainCacheHitRequestCount: Main agent calls with complete metrics and at least one input token served from cache. Cache hit rate per call (%) = calls with cache hits / calls with complete metrics × 100. Cached input token percentage = cached input tokens / input tokens × 100.
tooltips.modelUsage: Token records per LLM call, without prompts or customer content. main identifies the main agent; search identifies LLM calls made by knowledge-base search. Null token values mean unknown metrics, not zero. Per-component totals, averages and maximums only use calls with valid input, cached input and output token counts. Output tokens already include reasoning tokens. Cached tokens are part of input tokens and still occupy the context window.
tooltips.kind: How this run was triggered: 'customer-message' (a contact sent a message that the AI replied to), 'private-mention' (a human agent @mentioned the AI in a private note — internal usage, invisible to the customer), 'public-mention' (a human agent @mentioned the AI in a public reply), 'scheduled-message' (a scheduled private note without a mention dispatched into an AI-assigned conversation), or 'followup-trigger' (a scheduled follow-up fired without an inbound message). Rows persisted before the five-way split carry only the legacy binary values ('customer-message' includes old mention runs).
tooltips.agent: The AI agent membership that produced this run.
tooltips.conversation: The conversation handled by this agent run.
tooltips.tenant: Tenant associated with the run's Chat account. Set automatically and used for reports by tenant.
tooltips.triggerMessageId: The Chat message ID that triggered the run; empty for follow-up runs.
tooltips.triggerMessageAt: Time the triggering Chat message was created (start of the response-time measurement). Empty for follow-up runs.
tooltips.runAt: Wall-clock time the run finished and emitted the agent_completed event.
tooltips.durationMs: Run wall-clock time in milliseconds (start of streamText to end of the final step).
tooltips.leadTimeMs: End-to-end response time in milliseconds: from when the customer message was received in Chat (triggerMessageAt) to when the agent run completed (runAt). Includes webhook dispatch, queue wait and agent execution. Empty for follow-up runs.
tooltips.stepCount: Number of model invocation steps within this run.
tooltips.toolsUsed: Distinct tool names called during the run.
tooltips.inputTokens: Total input/prompt tokens consumed by the run, including the knowledge-base search tool's own Gemini calls (prompt + fileSearch tool-use tokens).
tooltips.outputTokens: Total output/completion tokens for the run, including reasoning tokens and LLM calls made by knowledge-base search.
tooltips.totalTokens: Total token count reported by providers across the main agent and knowledge-base search calls. Reasoning tokens are already included in Output Tokens and must not be added again.
tooltips.cachedInputTokens: Input tokens served from cache, including knowledge-base search calls. These tokens are already included in Input Tokens.
tooltips.reasoningTokens: Model reasoning tokens (also called thinking tokens), including search calls. Already included in Output Tokens: do not add them again. Empty means this metric was not recorded.
tooltips.opportunity: Opportunity whose stream mention triggered this agent run. Billed independently of linked conversations, using the tenant rate for mentions.
tooltips.sourceNote: The operator post that mentioned the AI. One agent run is recorded per source post and AI membership.
tooltips.hatchetWorkflowRunId: UUID of the opportunity-stream workflow that executed this agent run.
tooltips.model: LLM identifier used for this run (e.g. gemini-3-flash-preview).
tooltips.wasTransferred: True if the run invoked the transfer tool.
tooltips.hadAppointment: True if the run invoked the appointments tool.
tooltips.createdOpportunity: True if the run invoked the create_opportunity tool at least once. Path 3 split — supersedes the legacy hadOpportunity union flag; query the OR of the three per-action flags when you need 'any opportunity activity'.
tooltips.updatedOpportunity: True if the run invoked the update_opportunity tool at least once.
tooltips.deletedOpportunity: True if the run invoked the delete_opportunity tool at least once.
tooltips.sentFollowupMessage: True if the run invoked the send_followup_message tool — i.e. the AI agent actually emitted a follow-up message rather than terminating via a deliberate opportunity update (Ended / ActionNeeded) or a silent-done failure. Always false on customer-message runs (the tool is only registered on the follow-up arm).
tooltips.hatchetEventId: UUID of the originating Hatchet `chatwoot://agent_completed` event in the v1_events_olap table. Use it to cross-reference this row with Hatchet's UI / logs / REST API. Always set for backfilled rows; populated by the live consumer via a per-run REST lookup of event.list({workflowRunIds:[ctx.workflowRunId()]}).
